title: Wim Hof Method Guided Breathing for Beginners (3 Rounds Slow Pace)
summary: A guided Wim Hof breathing session of three rounds at a slow pace, building from a 30 second to a 90 second breath hold. An on-screen bubble animation helps you keep the rhythm.
why: HN commenters share it as a gentle beginner session and as a way to wind down before sleep.
